title: One-tap computer component lessons
summary: Bring the phone learning experience to laptop and desktop parts with localized assembly guidance and offline practice.

changes.detail: Understand, Assembly and Try it sections, connected-part navigation, component quizzes, next-piece control and custom AI questions.
Replaced English-only generic assembly notes with Arabic/French/English guides distinguishing laptop soldered CPU/GPU, SO-DIMM RAM and main batteries from desktop components.
Photo taps, picker and component list now open lessons with one action; existing layer reveal, zoom and saved progress retained.
